scope: Luna high Tokyo top-up STANDARD macro 2. Only nissay-theatre, line-cube-shibuya, and kioi-hall were reviewed.

outcomes.firstPass: official current seat map and official theatre overview reviewed; dense 1F, G.C., 2F, and curved box areas require lossless range transcription
outcomes.independentSecondPass: independent reread confirmed the same multi-area structure and official 1,334-seat count; no complete row/omission/area extraction was promoted
outcomes.blocker: The official map is a high-density multi-area layout. Exact numbered ranges, omissions, and area boundaries for the curved box seats were not losslessly completed at Luna quality; fitting ranges to 1,334 is prohibited.

outcomes.firstPass: official current three-page seat map and facility guide reviewed; normal total and floor subtotals match
outcomes.independentSecondPass: independent reread confirmed 1,956 total, 1F 1,180, 2F 424, 3F 352, plus 4 multipurpose seats and 12 wheelchair spaces/26 first-floor seats used
outcomes.blocker: Official material does not define one fixed selectable numbered-seat set for the multipurpose 4 seats and wheelchair conversion of 26 first-floor seats. Do not exclude or include numbers only to fit 1,956.

outcomes.firstPass: current official facility, seat chart, closure notice, and reopening page reviewed
outcomes.independentSecondPass: independent reread confirmed 800 seats and 2025-10 seat chart, but current official closure/reopening state prevents treating that chart as the post-renovation representative pattern
outcomes.blocker: Official notice states closure from 2025-08-01 through the end of 2026, and the reopening page schedules reopening commemorative performances from January 2027. Wait for post-renovation current seat material; do not escalate or reuse the pre-renovation map.

summary.nextRecommended: Terra high nissay-theatre and Sol high line-cube-shibuya escalation; keep kioi-hall closed until post-renovation official material, then consider Luna high STANDARD macro 3 for kameari-lirio-hall.
